title: The Glastonbury Boathouse

services.name: Pontoon “Slipaway” Tours
services.desc: Experience the Connecticut River from the deck of the Slipaway pontoon boat! The Slipaway is a Coast Guard-inspected pontoon boat that offers covered seating and a restroom. Tours offer narrations on local history, natural beauty, areas of interest, and highlight the River as a regional treasure.
